content:
nina: Quick thread — idea to test "scenario presets" in the pricing calculator (e.g., chatbot, embeddings-search, fine-tune) instead of raw inputs. Reason: reduces friction and gives clearer plan recs.
corey: +1. presets map to token/profile templates so estimate is faster. also gives us narrative hooks for the launch blog/webinar.
olivia: love that. webinar angle: 'How to predict inference costs for your LLM use case' demoing presets + live Q&A. target: devs & platform teams.
rahul: routing rules: preset -> default concurrency & seqlen assumptions. if user picks "Enterprise+" rec, send to SDR; else capture email for webinar follow-up.
pricingbot: Created experiment PRJ-7264: scenario_presets_variants, variantA=inline-presets, variantB=advanced-form
sara: variant copy suggestions: preset labels: Conversational Assist, Vector Search, LLM-Powered App
nina: alternate tier names for mapping bands: Foundational ($0-2k), Growth ($2k-15k), Enterprise+ (>$15k). want to test whether 'Foundational' reduces sticker shock vs 'Starter'.
corey: + test two label sets in same experiment? could be messy. maybe sub-experiment on CTA wording.
olivia: webinar promo: add a CTA in estimator results: "Join workshop: optimize your estimate" with 1-click add to calendar. drives demo pipeline.
rahul: analytics: events needed: preset_selected, estimate_viewed, cta_clicked, webinar_signup, routed_to_sdr. I'll add in GTM.
sara: FAQ update: add Q "What do presets assume?" copy: "Each preset uses a recommended token profile (avg tokens per call), concurrency p95, and batching heuristics. Estimates show conservative monthly spend for production traffic."
pricingbot: Note: PRJ-7264 linked to feature-branch: feat/pricing-presets. CI passed.
nina: timeline: prototype in staging by Tue, run 3-week AB test, webinar scheduled wk2 of test.
corey: dev notes: include hidden fields utm=presets_launch + preset_id for routing. also we should store estimated_band for quick segmenting.
olivia: landing page copy: headline "Realistic LLM cost estimates for your use case" subhead: "Pick a common scenario and get a tailored projection in seconds."
rahul: routing detail: if estimate_band == Enterprise+ -> immediate SDR slack ping + create lead in CRM with note "est>15k"
sara: legal okayed the FAQ blurb. small change: replace "conservative" with "conservative-to-moderate"
corey: will build presets + CTA, pushing to staging today. tagging @nina for copy review.
nina: awesome. follow-ups: olivia will draft webinar page + email, rahul will add events, corey builds, sara updates FAQ. sync Fri 9am. :calendar:
